control.justification: One current-source starter control is necessary after optimizer/API/observer fixes. This is a new scientific source cohort, not a rerun solely for a merge or a seed repetition. The historical 15eb result remains frozen.

selection_objective: required PASS count by ascending tuning tier (descending); configuration hash (ascending)

stage_b.held_pace: selected whole recipe's discriminator ratio and absolute sampled-prior step
stage_b.revision_reason: Revises the audit's unexecuted >=4-pass proposal before spending: intermediate rates can resolve ring HQ/covariance tradeoffs even when pacing does not add a complete gate.

stage_c.selection_scope: all admitted Stage A and Stage B whole recipes
stage_c.held_pace: selected whole recipe's generator rate, discriminator ratio and absolute sampled-prior step

activation.execution_completeness: All seven actual task attempts must reach terminal evidence for every admitted recipe before conditional selection; a selected row requires PASS/FAIL on all seven. Missing, invalid or incomplete selected evidence cannot activate a branch.

prior_evidence.reuse: Only exact current source/runtime/protocol/task/job compatibility may be reused; these historical receipts do not qualify the changed trainer.
